generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Convert budget, time, permission, data, security, quality and side-effect requirements into enforceable constraints, including what approvals will be required.

contract.purpose_user_function: Compile user budget/time/permission/data/security/quality/side-effect requirements into fields enforced by planning and gates.
contract.valid_inputs: Requirement IR, explicit constraints/prohibitions, approval needs, budgets/timeouts, scopes, data/security policy, quality and effect requirements.
contract.expected_outputs: Normalized constraint/approval fields in task contract/graph plus compile/gate obligations.
contract.state_side_effects: Writes contract/graph artifacts; later gates enforce them.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Unrepresentable/contradictory constraints, illegal scope, forbidden effect, missing approver, or policy conflict blocks compilation.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Scope, proof, policy, gate and timeout constraints are shipped across schemas/compiler; a single comprehensive constraint compiler is partial.
contract.success_evidence: Every explicit constraint appears in contract/graph and violating plans fail compile/gate checks.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: budget/time; write scope; permission/approval; data/security; quality/evidence; forbidden effect; conflict.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md §Basic Workflow; docs/solar-architecture-code-map.md §§1 and 5; docs/UNIFIED_ORCHESTRATOR_DESIGN.md §2.1 Intent parser
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: harness/lib/intent_gateway.py: infer_mode(), deterministic_rewrite(), build_requirement_ir(), capture(); harness/lib/intent_engine_adapter.py: match(), learn(), main()
contract.platform_provider_limitations: Deterministic matching is local; optional model rewriting depends on configured model access. Natural-language completeness and clarification policy remain partly heuristic.

implementation.interfaces: harness/lib/intent_gateway.py: infer_mode(), deterministic_rewrite(), build_requirement_ir(), capture(); harness/lib/intent_engine_adapter.py: match(), learn(), main()
